summary: Iter 12: validated sync OS<->Laudo / flush-on-close / fresh-on-open fixes. CENARIO 2 (fresh-on-open OS modal) PASS, CENARIO 4 (flush-on-close from OrderDetailModal via Escape) PASS. CENARIOS 5/6/7 (open LaudoModal then interact) BLOCKED — Playwright click on '[data-testid=laudo-type-hisense]' did not transition the LaudoModal from the type selector to step-1 within 30s, so we never reached laudo-diagnosis / laudo-parts inputs. This is a TEST-HARNESS limitation in this run (force=False on a button covered by a Dialog overlay layer), not a confirmed product bug; the same test path worked in iter 11. Backend reset, login, and all REST calls executed via in-page fetch with admin token (len=285).

integration_issues.issue: click on laudo-type-hisense without force=True intermittently does not transition to step 1 — investigate if button is wrapped in a focus-trapping layer or if Dialog overlay is intercepting

action_items: Main agent: re-run the 3 LaudoModal scenarios (C5/C6/C7) with force=True click on laudo-type-hisense, or pre-select laudoType via test hook, to confirm bidirectional sync end-to-end. Functional fixes from iter 12 (fresh-on-open + flush-on-close + applyOrderUpdates reducer) are confirmed for the OS-modal side: C2 (external edit shows immediately) and C4 (fast-close flush) both PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: ServiceOrdersPage.js > 700 lines — keep splitting OrderDetailModal into its own file (already at line 1654).

LaudoModal useEffect dep array has eslint-disable; the inline best-effort save inside the `if (!open)` branch in the open/order effect is safe but couples open/close logic with the data effect — extract to a dedicated effect that fires only on `open` transitions.
ServiceOrdersPage handleOrderClick + handleOpenLaudo duplicate the GET-then-merge logic — extract to a small helper to keep DRY.
applyOrderUpdates is correctly used as single mutation reducer — good. Consider also calling it after handleUpdateOrder() success so the manual Save also goes through the same path.

success_rate.frontend: C2 PASS, C4 PASS, C5/C6/C7 BLOCKED by test harness

seed_data_creation: OS 27691 reset between every scenario via PUT (technical_diagnosis/required_parts/voltage_*/technician/photo_1 cleared).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use page.evaluate fetch with token from localStorage('token') — direct urllib from script host fails. For laudo type-selector, use force=True and prefer clicking via locator('button:has-text("Laudo Hisense")').first or wait for [data-testid=laudo-modal-title]:has-text('Laudo Técnico') to confirm transition. C1 (photo sync) was not executed due to harness time; main agent or next tester should validate via base64 PNG injected through the hidden file input inside ImageUploadField (input is inside [data-testid=image-upload-0] container).
rca of the issue: Iter 12 product fixes verified for the OS-modal direction (fresh-on-open + flush-on-close). Bidirectional path (Laudo->OS, OS->Laudo via Gerar Laudo) needs re-validation with a more robust selector path for the LaudoModal type selector.
